name: Nara, Cartógrafa das Trilhas
action: Cartographer: frame1 holds the folded map low with compass near waist; frame2 opens the map chest-high with both hands; frame3 head turns and one arm extends compass outward to check direction; frame4 holds the unfolded map angled outward in one hand and points to a route on it with the compass hand.

name: Bento, Catador de Cogumelos
action: Forager: frame1 holds mushroom near basket; frame2 raises mushroom to eye level to inspect it; frame3 leans forward and sniffs mushroom with wrinkled nose; frame4 drops mushroom into basket while lifting a second mushroom to chest height with the other hand, smiling.

name: Baltasar, Colecionador de Sinos
action: Bell collector: frame1 holds a small hanging bell at chest level; frame2 lifts the bell toward his ear; frame3 shakes the bell with an obvious wrist tilt and listens intently; frame4 holds bell outward at shoulder height and presses free index finger to lips.

name: Ofélia, Guardiã das Mariposas
action: Moth keeper: frame1 cradles cage low with both hands; frame2 raises cage chest-high; frame3 lifts cage lid slightly and peers inside while a moth remains perched on rim; frame4 holds cage chest-high on one forearm with free hand raised gently toward the perched moth.

name: Dário, Carvoeiro
action: Charcoal burner: frame1 shovel upright and sack low; frame2 plants shovel and brings free hand toward his forehead; frame3 visibly wipes brow with forearm; frame4 rests shovel diagonally against shoulder and extends free hand palm-up inspecting soot.

name: Ada, Funileira Ambulante
action: Tinker: frame1 holds kettle low; frame2 raises kettle to eye level; frame3 tilts kettle and taps its side with small tool held in other hand; frame4 holds tilted kettle chest-high and raises tool hand in a satisfied thumbs-up gesture.

name: Gaspar, Caçador dos Brejos
action: Marsh trapper: frame1 holds coiled snare in both hands at belt; frame2 pulls cord loop wide at chest level; frame3 lifts the snare loop and examines its knot; frame4 holds tightened snare loop out toward viewer at shoulder height, free hand pulling cord taut.

name: Tereza, Caça-Ratos
action: Rat catcher: frame1 holds empty rat trap cage low; frame2 lifts cage chest-high; frame3 opens cage latch and peers suspiciously inside; frame4 holds trap sideways chest-high and points with free hand to its open latch.

name: Severino, Médico da Máscara
action: Masked physician: frame1 holds bundle of herbs waist-high; frame2 raises herbs toward the beak mask; frame3 uses free gloved hand to turn and examine a small glass vial in front of his eyes; frame4 holds vial overhead toward light and keeps herb bundle against chest.

name: Erasmo, Estudioso da Própria Sombra
action: Scholar: frame1 holds closed book in left arm; frame2 opens book with both hands chest-high; frame3 peers into book, mouth open, free right hand raised in a clearly visible argumentative gesture; frame4 tucks book under left arm and points accusingly down with fully extended right arm.

name: Rúben, Barqueiro do Brejo
action: Ferryman: frame1 holds pole upright; frame2 shifts both hands up pole and leans slightly to brace it; frame3 pulls pole toward chest with obvious arm motion and looks over his shoulder; frame4 braces pole diagonally across body with widely separated hands and turns head toward viewer.

name: Lia, Mensageira Perdida
action: Courier: frame1 holds wax-sealed letter low near dispatch bag; frame2 raises letter chest-high and studies seal; frame3 opens satchel flap with other hand and tucks letter inside; frame4 keeps satchel flap open with one hand and points outward with the other arm while looking along that direction.
